stem.text: The diagram shows a ball of weight $W$ hanging in equilibrium from a string.

stem.alt: Diagram of a ball hanging from a string attached to a hatched wall at an angle theta to the vertical, held away from the wall by a horizontal metal rod. Labels: T on the string, P horizontal to the right, W vertically downward, and theta at the wall.

stem.text: The string is at an angle $\theta$ to the vertical. The tension in the string is $T$. The ball is held away from the wall by a horizontal force $P$ from a metal rod.
What is the relationship between the magnitudes of $T$, $P$ and $W$?
